result.question: What is the trend in Apple's research and development spending over the last three fiscal years?
result.answer: Apple's research and development (R&D) spending has increased steadily over the last three fiscal years. In FY 2023 (period ending September 30, 2023), Apple reported R&D expense of $29,915 million [xbrl:0000320193-25-000079:us-gaap:ResearchAndDevelopmentExpense:2023-09-30]. In FY 2024 (period ending September 28, 2024), R&D expense rose to $31,370 million [xbrl:0000320193-25-000079:us-gaap:ResearchAndDevelopmentExpense:2024-09-28]. In FY 2025 (period ending September 27, 2025), R&D expense increased further to $34,550 million [xbrl:0000320193-25-000079:us-gaap:ResearchAndDevelopmentExpense:2025-09-27]. This represents a year-over-year increase of approximately $1,455 million from FY 2023 to FY 2024 (about 4.9%) and approximately $3,180 million from FY 2024 to FY 2025 (about 10.1%), indicating an accelerating upward trend in R&D investment.
